issues.description: Ruff UP007/UP035/UP045 disabled wholesale with a TODO instead of doing the Union -> A | None conversion this PR advertises.
issues.detail: The PR claims Union/Optional are banned, but the three rules that enforce that shape are silenced repo-wide with 'TODO: Remove these - it's a lot of errors'. Either land the auto-fix in this series or scope the ignore so new code is held to the new shape. Disabling enforcement while advertising the migration leaves both shapes coexisting indefinitely.

issues.description: default_raise shim and stale '<3.10 compatibility' comments left in wallet_request_types.py after 3.9 removal.
issues.detail: default_raise is documented as existing only for <3.10 compatibility, and the comment above TransactionEndpointRequest still references the <3.10 workaround. With 3.9 gone, either remove the shim and use real defaults or rewrite the rationale to state the actual current reason. Dead scaffolding misleads the next maintainer.

issues.description: install.sh version guard still accepts Python 3.7-3.9 while error message claims >=3.10.
issues.detail: Line 138 tests PYTHON_MINOR_VER -lt 7, but the printed message and pyproject both require >=3.10. A 3.8 interpreter passes the check and prints a contradictory message. Tighten the literal to 10 so the predicate matches the stated minimum supported version.

issues.description: Install-scripts CI step runs unused `dnf search python3.12` and hardcodes 3.12 instead of matrix version.
issues.detail: The Amazon/Rocky prep steps run `dnf search python3.12` with no assertion on output - pure noise that could non-zero-exit and kill the job. Worse, prep now pins python3.12 directly while the matrix tests 3.10/3.11/3.12, so those distros silently test only one interpreter. Drop the search and let the matrix drive the version.

issues.description: itertools.pairwise refactor is unrelated to 3.9 removal and should be applied uniformly or split.
issues.detail: Replacing zip(ordered, ordered[1:]) with itertools.pairwise in test_priority_mutex.py is a nice 3.10 win but mixes an unrelated cleanup into a mechanical version-removal patch. Either split it into its own diff or sweep the rest of the tree for the same pattern so the codebase carries one idiom, not two.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the mechanical 3.9 removal is correctly shaped where it actually deletes version forks (cmd_classes.py is exemplary), but the patch is half-done. The most serious gap: ruff's UP007/UP035/UP045 are silenced with a TODO while the PR description advertises a Union -> A | None migration - either land the auto-fix or don't claim the move. Stale <3.10 scaffolding remains in wallet_request_types.py (default_raise, comments), install.sh's guard contradicts its own error message by still allowing 3.7-3.9, and a debug `dnf search` line plus a hardcoded python3.12 snuck into CI prep. Finish the ruff conversion, strip the dead shims, and tighten install.sh before landing.
